method: One real Playwright Chromium first-person session. Opens modeled interior doors, plans over the live navigation snapshot, simplifies routes by line of sight, then walks each segment with real W key input and a slow joystick final approach and checks the camera position.
scope: Browser-rendered model navigation and visible interaction only. This does not establish measured as-built clearances, physical phone performance, or full-scale ergonomics.
